authority: Road Trip Adventure European PAL executable SLES_513.56

categories.label: Tyres
categories.known_role: six PAL surface grip coefficients; Big selector additionally drives cfg flag 0x0400
categories.selector_write_effect: record u16@+0x1a nonzero sets cfg flags 0x0400; zero clears it

categories.label: Engine
categories.known_role: drive-force scalar at +0x0c; final flag code is consumed by selector writer
categories.selector_write_effect: record u32@+0x14 code 1/2 selects cfg flag 0x0001/0x0002 after clearing both

categories.label: Chassis
categories.known_role: weight word at +0x0c is the live inverse-mass divisor source
categories.selector_write_effect: no category-specific selector-write side effect beyond selector byte

categories.label: Transmission
categories.known_role: eight signed reverse/forward/sentinel gear words at +0x0c
categories.selector_write_effect: no category-specific selector-write side effect beyond selector byte

categories.label: Steering
categories.selector_write_effect: no category-specific selector-write side effect beyond selector byte

categories.label: Brakes
categories.selector_write_effect: no category-specific selector-write side effect beyond selector byte

categories.label: Wheels
categories.known_role: wheel appearance selector; duplicated to configuration byte +0x06
categories.selector_write_effect: duplicates selected item to configuration byte +0x06

categories.label: Lights
categories.known_role: light equipment selector; nonzero state toggles cfg flag 0x0010
categories.selector_write_effect: nonzero selector sets cfg flag 0x0010; zero clears it

categories.label: Wing
categories.known_role: wing equipment selector; nonzero state toggles cfg flag 0x1000
categories.selector_write_effect: nonzero selector sets cfg flag 0x1000; zero clears it

categories.label: Special Parts
categories.known_role: propulsion equipment; record flag word distinguishes Propeller/Jet Turbine
categories.selector_write_effect: clears cfg flags 0x0040/0x2000 then ORs record u16@+0x0c

categories.label: Options
categories.known_role: optional equipment; record flags and variant byte are consumed by selector writer
categories.selector_write_effect: clears cfg flags 0x0004/0x0020/0x0100/0x0200, ORs record u16@+0x0c, copies record byte@+0x10 to cfg byte +0x07

categories.label: Stickers
categories.known_role: sticker equipment; nonzero state toggles cfg flag 0x4000
categories.selector_write_effect: nonzero selector sets cfg flag 0x4000; zero clears it

categories.label: Horns
categories.known_role: horn selection; audio switching role known, trailing word retained raw

categories.label: Meters
categories.known_role: meter selection; HUD switching role known, no extra selector-writer side effect
